description: Validation functions for input fields in a device UI, including checks for IP addresses, MAC addresses, SSID, passwords, and other input validation routines.

methods.name: isdigit
methods.description: Checks if the input value contains only digits 0-9.

methods.name: isascii
methods.description: Checks if the input value contains only ASCII characters between space and tilde.

methods.name: valid_range
methods.description: Validates if the input value is within a specified numeric range.

methods.name: valid_range_st
methods.description: Validates if the input value is within a specified range, with message based on a key.

methods.name: check_space
methods.description: Checks if the input contains any space characters.

methods.name: is_english_And_symbol
methods.description: Checks if characters are within ASCII printable range.

methods.name: valid_space_begin_end
methods.description: Checks if string does not start or end with whitespace.

methods.name: validation_ssid
methods.description: Validates SSID string for length, ASCII, and allowed characters.

methods.name: validation_key
methods.description: Validates password format (64 hex characters or 8-63 characters).

methods.name: valid_name
methods.description: Validates name with ASCII and optional space restrictions.

methods.name: valid_name1
methods.description: Validates name with allowed characters and optional space check.

methods.name: valid_device_name
methods.description: Validates device hostname for length, format, and starting character.

methods.name: valid_friendly_name
methods.description: Validates friendly name for length and allowed characters.

methods.name: valid_mac
methods.description: Validates MAC address in hex format, with multicast and special address checks.

methods.name: valid_mac_12
methods.description: Validates 12-character MAC address in hex, with multicast and special address checks.

methods.name: ignoreSpaces
methods.description: Removes all spaces from a string.

methods.name: trans16to2
methods.description: Converts a hex character to a 4-bit binary array.

methods.name: check_multicast_mac
methods.description: Checks if a MAC address is multicast.

methods.name: valid_mac_17
methods.description: Validates MAC address in colon-separated format, with various address checks.

methods.name: ValidateIPaddress
methods.description: Validates IPv4 address format.

methods.name: valid_ipaddr_empty
methods.description: Checks if IP address input fields are empty.

methods.name: valid_ipv6
methods.description: Validates IPv6 address format.

methods.name: validate_email
methods.description: Validates email address format.

methods.name: valid_url
methods.description: Validates URL format.

methods.name: valid_root_pwd
methods.description: Validates root password based on allowed characters and IMDA setting.

methods.name: check_contain_space
methods.description: Checks if a string contains any space characters.
